استأممت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْمَمْتُ (istaʔmamtu) /is.taʔ.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# اِسْتَأْمَمْتَ (istaʔmamta) /is.taʔ.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# اِسْتَأْمَمْتِ (istaʔmamti) /is.taʔ.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
